title:
Rest and Roost …

Our tenants has been busy making a commissioned piece of work for Middleton Shopping Centre 🏬 At the Landings Wellbeing Hub 

Over the past few months they have made Planters and sculptures out of recycled tyres 🛞 
Bird feeders and bug houses

And in collaboration with Maynineteen 

Yesterday we attended for our photo, proudly showing off our work! Well done everyone involved 🙏

#bluepitshousingaction #middleton
#crafts #maynineteen
